CVE-2026-59975.description: SharpIppNext is a .NET Standard library for building Internet Printing Protocol clients and servers. Prior to 4.1.0, server-side SharpIppNext implementations using SharpIppServer.ReceiveRequestAsync or SharpIppServer.ReceiveRawRequestAsync pass incoming data to IppProtocol.ReadIppRequestAsync in SharpIpp/Protocol/IppProtocol.cs, where ReadDocumentStream is enabled by default and the remaining document body is copied with CopyToAsync into a MemoryStream without a size limit. An unauthenticated remote client can send an arbitrarily large IPP document body, exhausting process memory and causing an out-of-memory failure or service termination. Client-only implementations using SharpIppClient are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 4.1.0.

CVE-2026-69131.description: django-filer is a file and image management application for Django. Prior to 3.5.0, the delete_files_or_folders action in filer/admin/folderadmin.py checks global Django model-level deletion permission but omits check_folder_edit_permissions and check_files_edit_permissions when FILER_ENABLE_PERMISSIONS is enabled. An authenticated staff user who has a global delete_file, delete_folder, or delete_image permission but is limited to read-only access by FolderPermission can therefore delete files, folders, and descendants from the restricted folder. Deployments using the default disabled per-folder permission system are not affected, and the issue does not create a read-confidentiality impact. This issue is fixed in version 3.5.0.

CVE-2026-69138.description: djangocms-versioning is a general-purpose versioning package for django CMS 4 and later. Prior to 2.6.1, the check_discard and check_edit_redirect Conditions on djangocms_versioning.models.Version omit user_can_change, while VersionAdmin.discard_view and VersionAdmin.edit_redirect_view obtain a version by its primary key and rely on those conditions for object-level authorization. With CMS_PERMISSION set to True, the affected views are gated only by is_staff, allowing any staff user to select content without object-level change permission. With the default CMS_PERMISSION value of False, a staff user must also hold the global Django change_ permission, but that model-level permission does not enforce the intended per-object authorization, so the user can delete a draft version and its content object through discard or create an editable draft from a published version through edit_redirect even when the user cannot change that specific content object. This issue is fixed in version 2.6.1.

CVE-2026-71427.description: WPGraphQL Content Blocks is a WordPress plugin that extends WPGraphQL to support querying Gutenberg blocks as data. Prior to 4.8.6, the editorBlocks renderedHtml field in includes/Data/ContentBlocksResolver.php uses resolve_content_blocks() to read a post with get_post() without applying post_password_required(). An unauthenticated caller who knows a supported post identifier can therefore retrieve the complete body of a password-protected published post without a post password, nonce, or valid cookie, exposing paid, member-only, preview, or internal content. This issue is fixed in version 4.8.6.

CVE-2026-73967.description: AnsibleForms is a self-hosted web application that turns automation into self-service forms. Prior to 6.2.1, AnsibleForms stores attacker-influenceable job output that server/src/lib/common.js processes through formatOutput without HTML escaping and client/src/components/AppAnsibleOutput.vue renders through v-html. An authenticated user can submit job input that is echoed into persistent output, causing script execution when another user views the job. Additional designer-controlled HTML and expression values reach v-html in client/src/components/AppForm.vue and client/src/components/BsInputForForm.vue without sanitization. Because Content Security Policy is disabled and the JWT is stored in localStorage, script execution can steal a victim's token and take over the account, including an administrator account. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.1.

CVE-2026-73968.description: AnsibleForms is a self-hosted web application that turns automation into self-service forms. Prior to 6.2.1, AnsibleForms allows a user with repository management privileges to inject shell syntax through repository uri, branch, name, or host values processed by server/src/models/repo.model.js. The Repo.clone and Repo.addKnownHosts paths interpolate these values into git and ssh-keyscan command strings, and server/src/lib/cmd.js executes the strings through Cmd.executeSilentCommand with shell interpretation enabled. Creating or updating a repository can therefore execute arbitrary commands as the AnsibleForms application process. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.1.

CVE-2026-73969.description: AnsibleForms is a self-hosted web application that turns automation into self-service forms. Prior to 6.2.1, AnsibleForms uses a public hard-coded fallback JWT signing secret from server/config/auth.config.js when ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET is unset. An unauthenticated attacker can sign a self-contained token with privileged claims because server/src/auth/auth_jwt.js verifies the signature without reloading the user from the database, and server/src/lib/middleware.js trusts the token's roles and options for authorization. A forged token can therefore be accepted as an administrator session, resulting in authentication bypass and full privileged API access. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.1.

CVE-2026-75506.description: OliveTin gives safe and simple access to predefined shell commands from a web interface. From 3000.0.0 until 3000.18.1, OliveTin passes attacker-influenceable output and ot_username values into shellAfterCompleted processing in service/internal/executor/executor.go without applying checkShellArgumentSafety, the shell-safety validation used for primary action execution. The same post-execution template path also expands exitCode without that validation, but the advisory does not establish attacker control of the exit-code value. When an action configures shellAfterCompleted with output or ot_username, shell metacharacters from command output, external data processed by an action, or a trusted-header username can become syntax in the command executed by the stepExecAfter path. This can execute arbitrary commands as the OliveTin process user, including when the primary action uses the safer exec-array mode. This issue is fixed in version 3000.18.1.

CVE-2026-75522.description: OpenID4VP is an open-source credential parsing library for SD-JWT VC and mDOC/mDL formats. Prior to 0.8.1, src/trust/ChainBuilder.ts ChainBuilder.tryBuild() terminates chain construction when an attacker-controlled certificate Subject Distinguished Name equals a trusted anchor subject, without verifying cryptographic closure to the anchor public key. A remote unauthenticated attacker can supply a self-signed leaf or intermediate that reuses the trusted Subject Distinguished Name and have credentials signed by the attacker key accepted as issued by the trusted authority. The public src/trust/TrustEvaluator.ts TrustEvaluator.evaluate() path compounds the error by matching a terminus through serialNumber and falling back to anchors[0], which can attribute the forged chain to genuine trusted-authority metadata. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.1.

CVE-2026-76007.description: IBM Engineering AI Hub 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information and perform unauthorized actions due to improper validation of a redirect URL.

CVE-2026-76088.description: PGPainless is a simple-to-use OpenPGP API based on Bouncy Castle. Prior to 1.7.8 and from 2.0.0 until 2.0.4, pgpainless-sop/src/main/kotlin/org/pgpainless/sop/InlineDetachImpl.kt InlineDetachImpl and pgpainless-core/src/main/kotlin/org/pgpainless/decryption_verification/MessageInspector.kt MessageInspector manually descend PGPCompressedData packets without incrementing or enforcing MAX_LAYER_DEPTH. A remote unauthenticated attacker can supply an untrusted OpenPGP message containing deeply nested compressed packet structures to a downstream application using inline-detach or message inspection, bypass the intended 16-layer limit, and force continued decompression and packet processing. The resulting resource consumption can block processing threads, exhaust heap memory, and crash the consuming application. This issue is fixed in versions 1.7.8 and 2.0.4.

CVE-2026-76100.description: OwnPay is a self-hosted open-source payment gateway automation platform. In 0.2.0 and earlier, modules/gateways/alipay/AlipayGateway.php fails open when an Alipay callback lacks a signature or the merchant has no configured public key because verify(array $callbackData, array $credentials) falls back to an undefined mode credential that defaults to test mode, while verifyWebhook() returns true unconditionally. An unauthenticated request to POST /webhook/{gateway} can provide a pending order reference and matching amount, pass both verification gates without a valid payment signature, and cause the order and corresponding payment-received ledger entries to be marked completed. No fixed version is available as of this review.

CVE-2026-76913.description: NotrinosERP is an open-source web-based enterprise resource planning system written in PHP and MySQL. From 1.0.0 until 1.1.0, the employee document handler in hrm/manage/employees.php allows an authenticated user with SA_EMPLOYEE permission to submit doc_file through tab_documents() and stores the raw client filename, including an executable extension, under company/0/documents/employees/ without extension, MIME, or content validation. Uploading a PHP file places executable content beneath the web root, where requesting the stored file results in server-side code execution. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.0.

CVE-2026-77295.description: MyMangaDB is a self-hosted manga collection manager with automatic metadata, MyAnimeList import, Docker support, and collection statistics. Prior to 2.7.2, the unauthenticated /api/v1/database/export handler in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/database.py returns a ZIP containing the live SQLite database and the cover-image library. The database includes the users table and hashed_password values, allowing a remote attacker to obtain all application data and conduct offline password attacks without a session or token. This issue is fixed in version 2.7.2.

CVE-2026-77296.description: MyMangaDB is a self-hosted manga collection manager with automatic metadata, MyAnimeList import, Docker support, and collection statistics. Prior to 2.7.2, the unauthenticated /api/v1/images/manga/save handler in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/image.py accepts a client-controlled filename and joins it to IMAGE_SAVE_PATH without confining the result. Traversal sequences can escape the image directory and overwrite process-writable files, including DATABASE_PATH for the live SQLite database, while the client-supplied image content type does not validate the uploaded bytes. An attacker can replace the database to plant an administrative user and can overwrite other writable files, causing full application compromise and availability loss. This issue is fixed in version 2.7.2.

CVE-2026-77297.description: MyMangaDB is a self-hosted manga collection manager with automatic metadata, MyAnimeList import, Docker support, and collection statistics. Prior to 2.7.2, the unauthenticated /api/v1/database/import handler in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/database.py accepts a ZIP archive and moves an included database file to DATABASE_PATH while also replacing IMAGE_PATH content. An attacker can supply a database containing an attacker-controlled users table and administrative account, then authenticate as that account; invalid replacement data can also destroy application data or availability. This issue is fixed in version 2.7.2.

CVE-2026-106094.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in Westell Technologies, Inc Remote series products on Linux allows OS Command Injection. This issue affects several generations of Westell Remotes: through firmware version 9.14. It has been reproduced across multiple devices. However, it is confirmed to affect only devices configured for RAS (Remote Access Server - e.g., RADIUS, TACACS).

CVE-2026-121720.description: OpenVPN 2.4.0 through 2.6.23 and 2.7_alpha1 through 2.7.8 on Windows allows local authenticated users to execute arbitrary code via a privileged service using user-controlled environment variables.

CVE-2026-129987.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the database password validation used by the MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, and Redis change-password procedures permits backticks, and the procedures interpolate attacker-controlled passwords into Bash command strings. An authenticated user who can update a database password can trigger command substitution before the database command runs, resulting in arbitrary operating-system command execution with the Dokploy process privileges, which are typically root. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

CVE-2026-129993.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the settings.getWebServerSettings protected procedure returns the complete global web-server settings object to any authenticated member, including the stored sshPrivateKey, even though settings.saveSSHPrivateKey requires an administrator. A default member can therefore retrieve infrastructure, deployment, or server-management credentials that only an administrator can configure. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

CVE-2026-132141.description: A vulnerability was detected in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. Affected by this issue is the function json_load_lock of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi of the component Jsonstatus. The manipulation of the argument usefile results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 can resolve this issue. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-132142.description: A flaw has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. This affects the function dataflowstatus of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi of the component CGI Process. This manipulation of the argument option causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to mitigate this issue. You should upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-132143.description: A vulnerability has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. This vulnerability affects the function doWebBackup of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi of the component Backup Handler. Such manipulation of the argument path/value leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to resolve this issue. The affected component should be upgraded. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-132252.description: A vulnerability was found in October CMS up to 4.4.6. This affects the function validateExternalImageHost of the file modules/system/classes/resizeimages/ValidatesExternalImages.php of the component Image Resizer. Performing a manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be initiated remotely. The complexity of an attack is rather high. The exploitability is reported as difficult. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 4.4.7 mitigates this issue. The patch is named f6372867006c03141944e7b57396a726eb02acf0. You should upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-132644.description: MISP contains an authorization flaw in the GalaxyCluster model's captureCluster() function, which handles the import and synchronization of Galaxy Clusters. Prior to the fix, any authenticated user holding the galaxy editor role could replace an existing locked Galaxy Cluster by supplying its UUID in an import request, regardless of which organization owned the cluster. The function unconditionally called captureOrganisationAndSG() before the save operation, overwriting the cluster's org_id and orgc_id fields with the importing user's organization, effectively transferring ownership of the cluster to the attacker's organization. Additionally, the save operation was not restricted to a specific set of fields, allowing arbitrary field modification. The vulnerable behavior required the attacker to possess a valid MISP account with the perm_galaxy_editor role and to know or discover the UUID of a target cluster belonging to another organization. No site-admin or owner-organization privilege was enforced for the update path. The result was that a low-privilege galaxy editor in one organization could modify the content (value, description, distribution, etc.) of clusters owned by other organizations and seize ownership, corrupting the integrity of shared threat-intelligence data across the MISP instance. The vulnerability was reported by ENISA and CERT.pl. The fix introduces an explicit authorization gate that restricts cluster updates to the owner organization, a sync user who can see the cluster via sharing-group rules, or a site administrator, and enforces a field allow-list that excludes org_id and orgc_id from update writes, preserving original ownership.

CVE-2026-132645.description: MISP contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the Galaxy import/sync functionality (captureGalaxy in app/Model/Galaxy.php). The captureGalaxy() method matched an incoming galaxy payload to an existing galaxy by UUID and unconditionally overwrote the matched record, regardless of whether the importing user belonged to the owning organization or whether the galaxy was a system-provided default galaxy. Any authenticated user holding the perm_galaxy_editor role could therefore: (1) demote a default galaxy by setting its default flag to false, (2) reassign the galaxy's org_id and orgc_id to the attacker's organization, effectively taking ownership, and (3) modify other galaxy fields (name, description, distribution, version). Additionally, the role-level permission check (perm_site_admin or perm_galaxy_editor) was executed after the captureOrganisationAndSG() call, meaning organization and sharing-group data was already captured before the authorization decision was made. The vulnerability requires an authenticated user with the perm_galaxy_editor role and the ability to submit a galaxy import payload containing a UUID that matches an existing galaxy. The security impact is loss of data integrity across the MISP instance: default galaxy definitions are corrupted, cross-organization ownership is silently transferred, and the integrity of shared threat-intelligence galaxy metadata is compromised for all users of the instance.

CVE-2026-59961.description: mini-snmpd is a minimal SNMP agent implementation. Prior to 1.7, the ASN.1 BER parser in protocol.c does not verify that an attacker-controlled field length is no greater than the remaining packet size before decode_str(), decode_oid(), and decode_ptr() evaluate size - len + 1. When len exceeds size, unsigned size_t arithmetic wraps and bypasses the bounds check, allowing the decoder to read beyond the 2048-byte packet buffer. Parsing occurs before the SNMP community string is checked, so a remote unauthenticated attacker can send one crafted request to UDP port 161 to crash the process and potentially disclose adjacent heap memory. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.

CVE-2026-62964.description: Gortex is a high-performance code-intelligence engine for AI agents and integrated development environments. Prior to 0.55.0, resolveFilePath in internal/mcp/tools_fileops.go accepts absolute paths without checking indexed repository roots, while write_file, edit_file, and move_inline in internal/mcp/tools_move_inline.go omit guardSymlinkWithinRepo before reaching AtomicWriteFile and related write sinks. A caller that can influence MCP tool arguments can therefore create or overwrite files anywhere the daemon user can access, including startup or hook files that execute code on a later trigger. The flaw violates Gortex's repository-confinement invariant and can lead to arbitrary host code execution. This issue is fixed in version 0.55.0.

CVE-2026-63411.description: Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI parameter description verbatim in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A parameter description containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

CVE-2026-63412.description: Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI query parameter name verbatim as an array key in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A query parameter name containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

CVE-2026-63413.description: Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI header parameter name verbatim as an array key in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A header parameter name containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

CVE-2026-63415.description: Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, Jane's Reference.php::doResolve passes an attacker-controlled OpenAPI $ref target to file_get_contents without restricting its scheme or resolved local path. When a victim generates code from an attacker-influenced document, an HTTP or HTTPS reference can cause requests to attacker-chosen or internal services, while an absolute or parent-relative path can read local JSON or YAML files and inline the retrieved content into generated output. Exploitation occurs during generation or CI processing and can disclose local files and internal-service responses. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

CVE-2026-68522.description: QPixel is a Q&A-based community knowledge-sharing software. Prior to 0.13.0, the unauthenticated comments#show action in app/controllers/comments_controller.rb resolves user-controlled comment IDs with Comment.unscoped, bypassing the Comment community default scope, and performs no deletion or post-visibility authorization check. A remote unauthenticated attacker can enumerate sequential IDs and read the full content of comments belonging to other communities, soft-deleted comments, and comments under access-restricted categories. The JSON response exposes the stored comment columns because the model has no limiting as_json override. This issue is fixed in version 0.13.0.

CVE-2026-69139.description: djangocms-moderation provides an approval workflow mechanism for organizations that require content approval before publication. Prior to 2.4.0, CollectionCommentAdmin and RequestCommentAdmin in the Django admin use changelist_view and changeform_view to scope comment access through caller-controlled object identifiers and model-level view_collectioncomment or view_requestcomment permissions without invoking ModerationRequest.user_can_view_comments() or an equivalent collection participant check. An authenticated staff user with either view permission can enumerate collection or moderation-request identifiers and read full comment messages for workflows they do not participate in. The exposure affects confidentiality of internal editorial discussions; comment creation, modification, and deletion remain protected, and integrity and availability are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 2.4.0.

CVE-2026-73971.description: Music Assistant is an open-source media library manager that integrates streaming services with connected speakers. Prior to 2.8.0, parse_arguments() passes the caller-controlled return_type parameter for config/core/get_value, config/providers/get_value, and config/players/get_value to parse_value() and Python eval() when resolving type parameters in music_assistant/helpers/api.py. Any authenticated user, regardless of role, can reach these commands through the WebSocket /ws endpoint or the REST JSON-RPC /api endpoint, causing arbitrary Python code to run with the Music Assistant server process privileges before command-handler validation, even if the request later fails. A default installation requires no special configuration, and compromise can expose secrets and configuration, alter library data, and control the application container. This issue is fixed in version 2.8.0.

CVE-2026-75518.description: DOMShell is a Chrome automation project whose MCP server exposes Unix-style tools for AI agents. Prior to 2.0.8, the DOMShell MCP server classifies the domshell_eval tool and eval command as read-tier operations that can run without --allow-write, even though eval shares the Runtime.evaluate dispatch path with the write-tier js command and has no side-effect gate. An MCP caller with tool-session access can therefore use domshell_eval to mutate DOM, window, or global state while the host approval interface, server authorization flags, denial messages, and audit records represent the operation as read-only. The bypass does not expose a capability beyond domshell_js for callers already authorized to write, but it violates the configured permission boundary for callers lacking that authorization. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.8.

CVE-2026-75612.description: yt-mcp is a YouTrack MCP server for Claude Code. Prior to 1.18.1, add_attachment in src/yt_mcp/tools/attachments.py accepts a caller-controlled file_path, checks only that the file exists, reads it without directory confinement, and uploads the bytes to a YouTrack issue. A compromised MCP client or an LLM steered by indirect prompt injection can read any file accessible to the server process and exfiltrate secrets through an issue the caller can access. The same release also permits get_project_health to interpolate a caller-controlled project value into snapshot filenames, allowing parent-directory traversal to write JSON files outside the snapshots directory. This issue is fixed in version 1.18.1.

CVE-2026-76101.description: keystore-go is a Go implementation of the Java KeyStore encoder and decoder. In 2.1.0 and earlier, keystore.Decode in decoder.go does not check the error returned when reading the trailing SHA-1 integrity digest and bounds its comparison by the length of the digest actually read. If an attacker with write access removes the final 20-byte digest from a modified JKS file, the empty actual digest causes the comparison loop to execute zero times and Decode returns the parsed keystore without an error. For certificate-only stores using TrustedCertificateEntry values, this bypasses both tamper detection and password verification, allowing trusted CA certificates to be added or replaced without knowing the keystore password and potentially enabling interception or modification of TLS connections that trust the forged CA. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.0.

CVE-2026-76818.description: Axon is an agent-agnostic context engine that gives AI coding agents continuous memory across sessions, tools, and machines. Prior to 0.1.1, rtk-install in src/axon/context/rtk_bootstrap.py uses _http_download() to fetch a prebuilt rtkx release archive and _extract_binary() to mark it executable, after which compress_text_with_rtk() invokes it without verifying a checksum, signature, or build attestation. If the sammyjdev/rtkx release pipeline or maintainer release credentials are compromised, an attacker can supply a modified binary that executes with the Axon process privileges when a user installs or automatically bootstraps rtkx. This issue is fixed in version 0.1.1.

CVE-2026-125353.description: An incorrect permission assignment vulnerability in Omada SDN Controller prior to 6.2.20 may cause a database backup generated during the uninstall workflow to remain readable by other local users on the host. Successful exploitation requires local, low-privileged access to the affected host and a retained uninstall backup. An attacker meeting these conditions could access the backup and disclose controller data without controller credentials.

CVE-2026-129315.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). In 0.31.0 and earlier, the hosted installer and manual installation instructions set /etc/dokploy to mode 0777, allowing a local non-root user on a shared host to replace root-owned schedule or Traefik configuration directories. Dokploy subsequently consumes those paths as trusted configuration and can execute substituted scheduled-task scripts as root, resulting in local privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-129316.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). From 0.29.13 until 0.31.0, the Docker terminal, container-log, and monitoring WebSocket handlers accept a caller-controlled serviceId as authorization but do not consistently bind the requested containerId or appName to that service. A member with read access to any service can consequently target unrelated containers, obtain a root shell in the Dokploy panel container, read other tenants' logs and statistics, and use the mounted Docker socket to compromise the host. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.0.

CVE-2026-129985.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, a user-controlled schedule appName is joined into the schedule directory path and interpolated without shell quoting into commands that create the directory and write the schedule script. An authenticated user who can create or update a dokploy-server schedule can inject operating-system commands that execute with the Dokploy process privileges when the schedule is saved, including root privileges on typical installations. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

CVE-2026-129986.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, mount.deleteFileMount passes a path containing the user-controlled filePath to the local removeFileOrDirectory helper, which interpolates it unquoted into rm -rf, while the remote branch is quoted. An authenticated member with file-mount create and delete permissions can execute arbitrary commands in the host context immediately when deleting a local file mount, without requiring a running container. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

CVE-2026-129989.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the Nixpacks publishDirectory build setting accepts shell metacharacters and is interpolated into a docker cp command executed through child_process.exec. An authenticated user with access to an application can execute arbitrary commands on the Dokploy host when triggering a Nixpacks deployment, leading to host compromise through the privileged Docker environment. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

CVE-2026-129990.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, every network.* procedure is only authentication-protected and does not require the Docker permission, allowing a standard member to list, inspect, create, import, recreate, resynchronize, and delete Docker networks. A member can disrupt service connectivity or alter network configuration, and create/import operations can target an unchecked serverId. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

CVE-2026-129991.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the backup prefix field is only checked for a nonempty value, and normalizeS3Path preserves shell metacharacters before the prefix is interpolated into rclone upload and retention-cleanup command strings. An authenticated organization member with backup permission for a service can execute arbitrary commands as root on the Dokploy host or configured remote server when a PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, libSQL, Compose, or web-server backup runs manually, on schedule, or performs retention cleanup. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

CVE-2026-129992.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.0, failed Railpack builds and database backups propagate an execution error containing the full command, exposing application environment variables, database passwords, and S3 access keys embedded in those commands. When the corresponding App Build Error or Database Backup notification setting is enabled, the disclosure can send secrets to email, Slack, Discord, Telegram, or webhooks; the same secrets are written separately to persistent Dokploy container logs, which may be accessible to more principals than the affected service. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.0.

CVE-2026-132279.description: A flaw has been found in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. Affected by this vulnerability is the function SqlUtils.sanitizeJdcUrl of the component JDBC URL Sanitization. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper input validation. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-132280.description: A vulnerability has been found in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. Affected by this issue is the function CheckBean of the file /api/jobs/exec of the component Quartz Handler. The manipulation of the argument methodName leads to improper input validation. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-71500.description: Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, _maybe_update_replicated_unlocked in mareforma/db/core.py does not check t_invalid in its new-claim gate, peer-selection query, or final update, so a claim marked invalid by a signed contradiction verdict can still be promoted to REPLICATED through convergence. The invalidated claim can also act as the corroborating peer that promotes an honest claim, bypassing the trust ladder's terminal refutation state. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

CVE-2026-71533.description: Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.7 until 0.3.8, search_claims in mareforma/db/core.py does not call _row_verified_on_read and therefore does not provide the same high-trust verification projection as query_claims. A forged or tampered REPLICATED or ESTABLISHED row that query_claims excludes can be returned by search_claims at its persisted trust level, and the missing verified marker prevents consumers from detecting that signature verification was skipped. The include_unverified option does not authorize this high-trust bypass. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

CVE-2026-71534.description: Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, restore logic in mareforma/db/restore.py derives transparency_logged from the unsigned rekor.uuid field inside signature_bundle without requiring a verified claim-bound rekor_inclusions entry, so an attacker who modifies claims.toml can falsely make a claim eligible for REPLICATED convergence. The same logic resets signed claims in non-Rekor graphs from transparency_logged 1 to 0 after restore, permanently preventing convergence because no Rekor refresh is configured. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

CVE-2026-71535.description: Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.7, the _maybe_update_replicated_unlocked convergence path in mareforma/db/core.py uses generated_by labels without requiring a valid signature_bundle from a distinct enrolled signer, so an unsigned claim written to a shared graph can converge with a signed peer and be promoted to REPLICATED. The forged trust state is returned by queries requiring REPLICATED support, allowing false multi-party endorsement signals to reach downstream consumers. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.7.

CVE-2026-71536.description: Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, verify_bundle in mareforma/export_bundle.py validates the outer DSSE envelope and exporter-signed subject digests, but JSONLDExporter._claim_node in mareforma/exporters/jsonld.py supplies no signatureBundle for individual claims. Because the exporter signs both the predicate nodes and their digest list, the check proves only internal bundle consistency and allows claims with missing, invalid, or forged asserter signatures to be accepted as authentic. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

CVE-2026-77283.description: obsidian-sync-mcp is an MCP server that gives AI agents access to Obsidian vaults. Prior to 0.5.7, deployments running without MCP_AUTH_TOKEN install no serverOptions.authenticate check for the HTTP /mcp endpoint, so requests are dispatched without validating the Host or Origin headers. A malicious website visited by the operator can use DNS rebinding to reach loopback, LAN, VPN, or container-published addresses, or directly issue a cross-origin request to loopback, and invoke the MCP tool surface to read, create, overwrite, delete, or move vault notes. Deployments using MCP_AUTH_TOKEN are not affected because browsers do not attach the bearer token. This issue is fixed in version 0.5.7.

CVE-2026-127039.description: The certificate authentication info handling in gnutls from 2.5.9 up to 3.8.13 does not reset the certificate count and list pointer when re-allocation of raw_certificate_list fails, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service for a peer under heap pressure.

CVE-2026-127040.description: The RSA-PSK ClientKeyExchange handler in gnutls before 3.8.14 does not return after detecting a memory allocation failure when copying the PSK username, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service for a peer under heap pressure.

CVE-2026-127231.description: A double free in the X.509 name constraints enforcement of GnuTLS 3.8.13 on all platforms allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service (application crash) via a certificate chain containing a NameConstraints extension processed while the application is under memory pressure. When an already populated name constraints object is reinitialized, previously freed list pointers are not cleared, so a memory allocation failure precisely at reinitialization leaves a dangling pointer that is freed again during a later cleanup.

CVE-2026-132281.description: A vulnerability was found in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. This affects the function SqlUtils.batchExecute of the file /api/database/upload of the component Database Maintenance Module. The manipulation results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-132282.description: A vulnerability was determined in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. This vulnerability affects the function FileUtil.upload of the file /api/localStorage of the component File Upload Handler. This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-132283.description: A vulnerability was identified in Directus up to 12.7.0. This issue affects the function AuthenticationService.refresh of the file api/src/services/authentication.ts of the component Authentication Service. Such manipulation leads to session expiration. The attack can be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

CVE-2026-132745.description: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrative users to inject SQL through the k (does not contain) comparator in list view search_params. Attackers can send crafted search_params to the ListAjax getRecordsCount mode, breaking out of the unescaped NOT LIKE clause to extract database contents via boolean or time-based techniques.

CVE-2026-132746.description: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to inject SQL via unescaped clientid values in the wsapp_map webservice operation. Attackers can register a sync application with wsapp_register, then send delete-mode entries with quoted clientid values processed by SyncServer.php to extract database contents including administrator access keys.

CVE-2026-132747.description: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with export access to inject SQL through unvalidated selected_ids values in ExportData.php. Attackers can send a UNION SELECT payload in selected_ids[] to the ExportSelectedRecords mode and read password hashes and access keys from the exported CSV.

CVE-2026-132748.description: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a PHP code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject code via the updatedFields parameter into config.inc.php. Attackers can supply a crafted HELPDESK_SUPPORT_EMAIL_ID value that passes email validation but closes the PHP string literal to execute arbitrary operating system commands.

CVE-2026-132749.description: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in ReportRun::generateAdvFilterSql() that allows authenticated low-privileged users to inject SQL via the bw comparator. Attackers can send a crafted advanced_filter parameter containing a single quote to the Reports getRecordsCount action to break out of BETWEEN literals and extract database contents.

CVE-2026-132750.description: Meilisearch before 1.55.1 and 1.56.x before 1.56.1 contains a quadratic memory consumption vulnerability in filter-parser that allows attackers with a search API key to exhaust server memory. Attackers can send a roughly 100 KB filter, such as a _geoPolygon with thousands of coordinates, to the search endpoint, crashing the server and taking all indexes offline.

CVE-2026-132751.description: yt through 4.4.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute Python code by supplying a crafted con_args attribute in a ytdata HDF5 file. SavedDataset._parse_parameter_file() passes con_args to eval() unrestricted, so loading a malicious .h5 file with yt.load() runs attacker code as the user.

CVE-2026-132752.description: ScreenTinker before 3.2.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the GET /api/kiosk/:id/render endpoint that allows users with kiosk page edit rights to store javascript: URLs in page buttons. Attackers can trigger script execution in the dashboard origin when an administrator activates the button, hijacking the victim's session and taking full control of the instance.

CVE-2026-132753.description: MP4v2 through 2.1.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in MP4RtpHintTrack::GetPayload() in src/rtphint.cpp that passes an unchecked rtpmap value to strchr(). Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file whose RTP hint track has a corrupted hinf atom to crash mp4info or applications calling MP4GetHintTrackRtpPayload().

CVE-2026-132754.description: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in File_Mpeg4::meta_iloc that allows attackers to trigger a global buffer over-read via oversized iloc field sizes. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with invalid offset_size or length_size values to overrun the BitStream_Fast mask table and crash applications analysing the file.

CVE-2026-132755.description: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in tfsxml_leave() caused by an off-by-one error when handling generic <! markup in truncated XML. Attackers can supply a crafted media file with malformed ADM XML parsed by File_Adm.cpp to crash MediaInfo or applications using MediaInfoLib.

CVE-2026-132756.description: Geany through 2.1.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to run shell commands by embedding metacharacters in filenames substituted into build and execute commands. Attackers can craft a file named with backticks or $(...) that executes via /bin/sh when a user runs Compile, Build or Execute, gaining code execution as the user.

CVE-2026-132757.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in DoWriteMeta() in src/isomedia/isom_store.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via crafted files. Attackers can supply an ISOBMFF file with a meta box containing an iloc entry but no dref box, crashing MP4Box during rewrite operations like -unhint.

CVE-2026-132758.description: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to crash the application through an unmatched closing ProtoDeclare element. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT-A scene file with a mismatched closing ProtoDeclare or ExternProtoDeclare element, causing a dereference of a NULL parsing_proto pointer and denial of service.

CVE-2026-132759.description: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because gf_node_free() frees nodes without detaching routes that still reference them via FromNode. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTO graphs so gf_sg_route_del() accesses freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting the heap.

CVE-2026-132760.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_isom_get_meta() in src/isomedia/meta.c that reads file->moov->trackList without checking the moov box exists. Attackers can supply a crafted ISOBMFF file with malformed AV1 configuration data that leaves moov unset, crashing MP4Box -infon and causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-132761.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_node_try_destroy that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by supplying crafted XMT scene files. Commands created inside a PROTO scope keep a raw pointer to a freed prototype sub-scene graph, which is read during teardown, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-132762.description: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a divide by zero vulnerability in DumpTrackInfo() in applications/mp4box/filedump.c that fails to check the media timescale for zero. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with a zero media timescale to make MP4Box -infon raise SIGFPE and crash, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-132763.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() that allows attackers to write a zero byte outside the heap line buffer via crafted XML attribute values. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a ROUTE or command referencing an undefined node, imported with MP4Box, to crash the process and corrupt memory.

CVE-2026-132764.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves ROUTE commands of a discarded node queued after being freed by gf_sg_command_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file imported with MP4Box so xmt_resolve_routes() writes to freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing the process.

CVE-2026-132765.description: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_node_try_destroy because Conditional node commands keep raw pointers to target nodes freed by gf_sg_reset(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene processed with -info or -add to trigger heap use-after-free, crashing the process and corrupting heap memory.

CVE-2026-132766.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in MP4Box because gf_sg_reset frees DEF'd proto sub-graph nodes without removing them from the GF_Proto node_code list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTOs so gf_sg_proto_del unregisters freed nodes during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

CVE-2026-132767.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via unchecked field lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose atIndexField names a non-existent node field, causing a NULL read during import and denial of service.

CVE-2026-132768.description: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c that leaves freed forward-referenced nodes cached in parser->peeked_nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a node targeted by an SFCommandBuffer command, triggering a later DEF lookup on the freed node and crashing MP4Box.

CVE-2026-132769.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in xmt_parse_script_field() that allows attackers to trigger a heap out-of-bounds read via duplicate Script field names with conflicting types. Attackers can craft an XMT file that, when imported with MP4Box, causes gf_sg_vrml_mf_reset() to treat a single-value field as multi-value, crashing the application.

CVE-2026-132770.description: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_proto() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash the process via a redefined ProtoDeclare name. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a duplicate ProtoDeclare name, causing gf_sg_proto_new() to return NULL and crashing MP4Box during import.

CVE-2026-132771.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in ReplaceDEFNode that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by triggering access to a partly freed child list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file whose InputSensor command buffer cascades prototype sub-graph deletion during gf_sg_vrml_parent_destroy, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-132772.description: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT parser that leaves parser->command_buffer pointing into a freed InputSensor node. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file triggering a parse error so xmt_node_start() writes NULL into freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing MP4Box.

CVE-2026-132773.description: Attendize through 2.8.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in EventOrdersController::postCancelOrder() that allows authenticated organisers to cancel attendees belonging to other accounts' events. Attackers can cancel one of their own orders while supplying foreign attendee IDs, which Attendee::findFromSelection() loads unfiltered, invalidating tickets for any event on the installation.

CVE-2026-132774.description: Attendize through 2.8.0 contains a cross-account authorization bypass vulnerability in EventAttendeesController::postMessageAttendees() that allows authenticated organisers to message other accounts' attendees by supplying a foreign event_id. Attackers, including self-registered organisers, can post to the attendees message endpoint for another event to send arbitrary emails to all attendees, enabling phishing and impersonation.

CVE-2026-132775.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by attaching nodes from unrelated proto sub-graphs to field-replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene buffering such a command in a Conditional node, causing gf_node_try_destroy() to access the freed node, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

CVE-2026-132776.description: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying crafted XMT files. Attackers can assign a second node to an SFNode command field so xmt_node_end() frees a forward-referenced child still cached in peeked_nodes, triggering a crash during DEF lookup in xmt_find_node().

CVE-2026-132777.description: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in Conditional_execute() because SetupConditional() stores a BIFS decoder pointer that gf_sm_load_run_isom() later frees without clearing. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with a BIFS Conditional node processed with -nstatx to crash MP4Box and potentially corrupt the heap.

CVE-2026-132778.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_field_is_sftime_offset() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via crafted files. CVE-2026-104357.description: A flaw was found in libtirpc. The SunRPC UDP/datagram server transport reuses a single receive buffer across requests and resets the XDR decode position without rebinding the decode length to the size of the datagram actually received. As a result, when a short UDP RPC request is received after a longer one, the XDR decoder can read stale bytes left in the reused buffer and interpret them as part of the current request, including credential, verifier, or procedure-argument fields. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to data confidentiality and integrity for services that use a UDP-based SunRPC server.

CVE-2026-130888.description: A flaw was found in nbdkit. The qcow2dec filter's zstd_compressed_cluster() function incorrectly sets the ZSTD input buffer size to the uncompressed cluster size instead of the compressed buffer size. A crafted QCOW2 image with ZSTD-compressed clusters can trigger a heap over-read, leading to a denial of service and potentially exposing heap memory.

CVE-2026-84998.description: The NextScripts: Social Networks Auto-Poster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'comment_author' and 'comment_agent' Comment Fields in all versions up to, and including, 4.4.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload executes in an administrator's browser session when the administrator views the WordPress comment moderation queue, including pending and unapproved comments, meaning no prior approval of the comment is required for exploitation.

CVE-2026-108687.description: The SAML SSO Login WordPress plugin through 1.5.2 does not verify that the SAML assertion whose signature it validates is the same assertion it reads the user identity from, allowing unauthenticated attackers who hold a validly signed assertion for any identity to authenticate as any existing user, including an administrator, through XML signature wrapping.

CVE-2026-109555.description: The WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro plugins for WordPress are vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.0 and 6.17.0, respectively, via deserialization of untrusted input during database restore and staging reset. This is due to the database importer treating attacker-controlled text beginning with {WPSTG_BINARY} as trusted internal binary data and decoding its hexadecimal suffix into serialized bytes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to plant a malicious serialized object in their own profile. When an Administrator later performs an ordinary database-including restore or staging reset containing that value, and the restored profile metadata is loaded, either during the restore or in a later request, a built-in POP chain can be used to execute arbitrary code on the server. Additional built-in gadget chains allow arbitrary local file read in both WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro and arbitrary file deletion in WP STAGING Pro. The attacker does not require Administrator credentials or a copy of a backup, but exploitation does require the later privileged restore or reset.

CVE-2026-117678.description: Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity vulnerability in benoitc idna allows an attacker who controls a hostname passed to the library to exhaust CPU via an over-long xn-- label. idna:ulabel/1 in src/idna.erl hands every ASCII label that starts with xn-- to punycode:decode/1 without applying check_label_length/1, the 63-octet DNS label limit. punycode:decode/1 in src/punycode.erl builds its output with list appends in insert/4, so its cost grows super-linearly with the label length. A label of a few kilobytes keeps a scheduler busy for seconds to minutes before the label is rejected as invalid punycode. Every decode entry point reaches this path: decode/1, decode/2, to_unicode/1 and from_ascii/1. The encode path reaches it as well, because alabel/1 calls ulabel/1 on an ASCII xn-- label before its own length check, so encode/1, encode/2 and to_ascii/1 are affected for such input. This issue affects idna: from 0.5.0 before 8.0.0.

CVE-2026-121852.description: The AppPresser WordPress plugin before 5.0.0 does not properly escape the contents of its debug log when displaying it in the admin dashboard, and decodes escape sequences after sanitising input, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored XSS attacks against administrators when debug logging is enabled.

CVE-2026-129446.description: The WPO365 | SEAMLESS WORDPRESS + MICROSOFT INTEGRATION (WPO365 | LOGIN) WordPress plugin before 45.4 does not ensure the signature validated on a SAML response covers the element the user identity is read from, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge a response via signature wrapping and log in as any user, including administrators, when they can supply a single artifact signed by the configured identity provider.

CVE-2026-110461.description: The Comelit 1456B Multi-User Gateway, in firmware versions up to and including 2.10.0, is configured with static default passwords for multiple privileged roles. The JavaScript runs in the context and under the identity of the agent's session in the Agent Desk or the Single Conversation Desk. CVE-2026-129048.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Jacob N. Breetvelt WP Photo Album Plus wp-photo-album-plus allows Remote Code Inclusion.This issue affects WP Photo Album Plus: from n/a through 9.3.06.003.

CVE-2026-101167.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Dataprom Bilişim Teknolojileri LTD. ŞTİ. DataPer Access Control and Security Systems allows Privilege Escalation. This issue affects DataPer Access Control and Security Systems: before v14.15(2026/11).

CVE-2026-132043.description: In Eclipse Yasson versions 3.0 to 3.0.5, a race condition (CWE-362) exists in the handling of @JsonbNumberFormat. Yasson creates one java.text.NumberFormat instance per annotated property and shares it across all threads that use the same Jsonb instance. NumberFormat is not thread-safe, and the deserializer called parse() on it without synchronization. When multiple threads deserialize concurrently, a thread can receive a numeric value that belongs to another thread's input, receive an incorrect value, or fail with an exception. A remote attacker who can send concurrent requests to an application that deserializes untrusted JSON this way may cause incorrect data to be processed or cause another user's value to be returned. Exploitation requires that the application use @JsonbNumberFormat with a shared Jsonb instance and that the attacker win a timing race. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.6 by synchronizing access to the shared NumberFormat instances.

CVE-2026-99320.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ipv6: raw: fix use-after-free in rawv6_send_hdrinc() rawv6_send_hdrinc() caches the route before handing the skb to l3mdev_ip6_out(). The VRF output path may replace skb->dst and release the original route, leaving the cached pointer stale. The function later dereferences that pointer for statistics accounting and as the output device passed to NF_HOOK(). Its RCU read-side critical section starts after l3mdev_ip6_out(), so it cannot prevent the old route from being reclaimed in between. Reload the route from the current skb destination after l3mdev_ip6_out() returns. KASAN reports a slab-use-after-free in rawv6_sendmsg(), with the route allocated by ip6_dst_alloc(), freed by dst_destroy() from rcu_core(), and the related RCU callback queued from vrf_l3_out().

CVE-2026-110728.description: The AIKTP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass via Predictable Token in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.7. The vulnerability exists because the plugin's sync token (`aiktpz_token`) is generated using PHP's non-cryptographic `uniqid()` function — producing a wall-clock-derived value with approximately one million microsecond candidates per uncertain generation second — while the unauthenticated, unthrottled REST endpoint `/wp-json/aiktp/checkToken` (registered with `permission_callback => __return_true`) acts as a public brute-force oracle for the token; simultaneously, the capability checks in `check_valid_token` and its wrappers (`verify_aiktp_token_with_edit_capability`, `verify_aiktp_token_with_upload_capability`) inspect only a server-side stored Administrator account (option `aiktp_author`) rather than the actual REST caller, meaning possession of the token alone grants Administrator-equivalent authority to any external request. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to recover the sync token and then invoke `POST /wp-json/aiktp/createpost` to publish arbitrary posts attributed to a site Administrator, `POST /wp-json/aiktp/doUpdatePostWithImageURL` to overwrite the body content of any existing post, and `POST /wp-json/aiktp/doUploadImageToWP` to import remote media and attach it as the featured image of any post. Additionally, when the `aiktpz_token` option has never been initialized, the `checkToken` oracle returns success for an empty token submission due to a loose comparison in `check_valid_token`, providing a zero-effort bypass that requires no brute-forcing whatsoever.

CVE-2026-126631.description: A flaw was found in OpenSCAP. This vulnerability allows for information disclosure when performing offline scans of untrusted filesystem images, such as container images or virtual machine (VM) disks. Because the scanner does not properly restrict symbolic link (symlink) resolution to the target image's root directory, an attacker can supply a crafted image containing links pointing to files on the host system. When the scan runs, typically with elevated privileges, OpenSCAP follows these links to read sensitive host files and expose their contents in the scan report or manipulate compliance results.

CVE-2026-14491.description: The WP Duplicate – WordPress Migration Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.11 via the 'file_name' parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. The authentication bypass requires submitting the JSON boolean `true` as the `prod_key_random_id` value, which coerces against any non-empty stored secret so that the loose `!=` comparison evaluates to false, skipping the rejection branch entirely without knowledge of the secret.

CVE-2026-14492.description: The WP Duplicate – WordPress Migration Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.11 via the save_single_batch_file function. This is due to a PHP type-juggling authentication bypass via loose != comparison with no is_string() guard, combined with unsanitized base64-decoded path construction in save_single_batch_file() lacking any directory traversal containment. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to execute code on the server. Exploitation requires that the site owner has completed the plugin's initial setup so that the site_type and prod_key_random_id options are non-empty, though any non-empty secret value is bypassable via the type-juggling flaw.

CVE-2026-85776.description: The WP Duplicate – WordPress Migration Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Missing Authorization in versions up to, and including, 1.1.11. This is due to a missing capability check and missing nonce check on the start_zip_creation, start_zip_download, local_sync_get_init_root_files, and local_sync_get_files_by_key AJAX actions in the start_zip_creation_dev() and sibling functions. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to overwrite the plugin's prod_site_url setting so it points at an attacker-controlled host and enumerate arbitrary server directories, which when combined with a subsequent administrator-triggered sync results in an unsigned attacker-supplied ZIP archive being fetched, extracted via a WordPress-independent bridge deployed under the web root, resulting in remote code execution on the affected site.

CVE-2026-92613.description: In Eclipse iceoryx-rs, versions 0.0.11 to 0.0.13 and 0.1.0 as well as on the latest main branch. `SampleReceiver::<T>::take()` and `Sample::<T>::deref()` are safe functions that hand the caller a `&T` pointing at a chunk written by another iceoryx process, but the subscriber path neither requires `T: ShmSend` nor verifies that the received chunk is at least `size_of::<T>()` bytes / `align_of::<T>()`-aligned. A peer process that publishes an undersized chunk, or any chunk at all when the subscriber chose a pointer-bearing `T`, drives a `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` subscriber into out-of-bounds reads of adjacent shared-memory chunks or dereference of a publisher-controlled pointer. Resolution: It will not be fixed since this is a known limitation in iceoryx as it is the users responsibility to specify the same data type on sender and receiver side. [iceoryx2](https://github.com/eclipse-iceoryx/iceoryx2) is the successor of iceoryx-rs where the API is designed to prevent this by default. It is strongly recommended to migrate to iceoryx2 which is actively maintained and receives security support. The iceoryx-rs package has officially reached End-of-life and will not receive any features, bugfixes or security fixes.

CVE-2026-112216.description: Vulnerability involving the exposure of sensitive information in the URLs of the UOC Virtual Campus’s document upload feature. After completing a document upload, the application includes identifiers related to the active session—such as `apjsessionid`—and other internal parameters associated with requests and users in the HTTP GET request parameters. This data may be stored in the browser history and in server or proxy logs, or transmitted via the HTTP Referer header, depending on the configuration and browsing flow. Its inclusion in the URL could allow for the unauthorized disclosure of information to third parties with access to those logs or recipients.

CVE-2026-133001.description: FlowIntel contains an authorization flaw in its duplicate alert ingestion logic. When a duplicate alert is received and its content is updated, the ownership and visibility scope fields (owner user and owner organization) were not refreshed to reflect the connector's current scope. As a result, an alert that was originally created under a broader visibility scope retained that broader scope even after the connector's scope was narrowed or changed. This means that users or organizations that should no longer have visibility into a given alert could continue to access it, because the stale ownership fields were never updated during the duplicate-update path. The issue affected all duplicate updates, including those involving alerts in terminal review states and those recovered from uniqueness conflicts. Security impact: - Unauthorized disclosure of security alert content to users or organizations outside the intended visibility scope. - Stale access persists indefinitely until the alert is independently re-scoped or deleted. Affected version: <4.1.0.

CVE-2026-82948.description: The Guardian 2 alarm unit lacks a mechanism to authenticate control commands sent over 433.92 MHz, which allows an attacker to replay the static commands to impersonate activity. The attacker can also disarm or arm the system at will if a Nexsmart keypad (product link) is in use, thus compromising the functionality of the alarm system completely.

CVE-2026-82949.description: The static codes used for information transmission throughout the 433.92 MHz system of the Guardian 2 system allow an attacker in proximity to monitor the movements of users inside the premises where the sensors are set up. This is further aided by the fact that codes transmitted reveal sensor type, although sensor location cannot be inferred from this traffic alone.

CVE-2026-82950.description: The device only supports Wi-Fi protocols vulnerable to deauthentication attacks (WEP/WPA/WPA2). Should any event which would typically be logged to the user’s mobile device (such as arming or disarming the alarm or any tamper events) be incurred whilst the device is temporarily disconnected from its Wi-Fi network (such as via a deauthentication attack), those alerts will not be sent even after connection is regained.
