CVE-2026-127002.description: The RSVP and Event Management WordPress plugin before 2.7.19 does not escape a submitted value before outputting it back in its RSVP form when the form is re-displayed after a failed submission, leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting which could be used against high-privilege users such as admins.

CVE-2026-130891.description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not check that a visitor is really the subscriber before showing them newsletters marked as private, and accepts a weaker subscriber identifier that anyone can obtain by submitting a known subscriber's email address to the public subscription form, allowing unauthenticated attackers who know a subscriber's email address to read every private newsletter sent to that subscriber.

CVE-2026-130892.description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not properly validate the destination of the redirect performed when a subscriber changes their list membership from a newsletter link, checking only that it begins with the site's URL, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect users to external sites whose address starts with the site's URL.

CVE-2026-130894.description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not protect its unsubscription actions against Cross-Site Request Forgery for subscribers it identifies from its own tracking cookie, allowing attackers to unsubscribe a subscriber from the site's newsletter by making them visit a malicious page.

CVE-2026-131971.description: The Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid WordPress plugin before 2.8.63 does not check that the visitor is allowed to view an invoice before rendering it through its single-invoice shortcode, and its payment-form embed page lets unauthenticated users render that shortcode for any invoice ID, disclosing customers' names, billing addresses, phone numbers, line items and payment status.

CVE-2026-131975.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not prevent format specifiers in a shortcode attribute from being interpreted when building navigation menu markup, which could allow users with a role as low as Contributor to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

CVE-2026-131976.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not prevent placeholders in a shortcode attribute from being expanded with unescaped nested shortcode output, allowing users with a role as low as contributor to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

CVE-2026-131977.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not escape the error message returned when a remote feed cannot be retrieved before outputting it, which could allow users with the contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators by pointing the feed at a server they control.

CVE-2026-131978.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not restrict which PHP functions a shortcode's filter attribute can call, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to remove WordPress' term-slug sanitization and perform SQL injection attacks through another shortcode's taxonomy term attribute.

CVE-2026-131979.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not restrict the content type of its lightbox shortcode, allowing users with the contributor role and above to make the lightbox fetch HTML from an attacker-controlled server and insert it into the page unsanitised, leading to Stored Cross-Site Scripting when a user opens the lightbox.

CVE-2026-131983.description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not apply the per-link visibility rules of space sidebar links when listing spaces in its space discovery feature, allowing unauthenticated visitors to retrieve the titles and URLs of links restricted to logged-in users or specific memberships, as well as disabled links, for every public and private space.

CVE-2026-131984.description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.7.0 does not verify that the user is allowed to manage the space it actually modifies or deletes, allowing a user who administers any one space to modify or permanently delete any other space on the site, together with its posts, comments, reactions and memberships.

CVE-2026-131985.description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not verify that a referenced media item belongs to the user, or is not already attached elsewhere, before re-linking it to their own content, and its media identifiers are predictable from public post data, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to take over and delete media uploaded by other users, including administrators.

CVE-2026-132042.description: The Keywords to Links Converter WordPress plugin before 2.2.5 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement via an AJAX action available to any authenticated user, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to perform SQL injection attacks and read arbitrary data from the database.

CVE-2026-132044.description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.8.0 does not check that a lesson belongs to the course a course creator is authorised to manage before moving it, allowing a user with the Course Creator role to move lessons out of other creators' courses into their own and read their content.

CVE-2026-132073.description: The Keywords to Links Converter WordPress plugin before 2.2.5 does not validate a value submitted to one of its AJAX actions before saving it as an option that it later uses in an arithmetic operation on every admin and front-end request, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to make the whole site return a fatal error until the option is manually reset.

CVE-2026-132081.description: The Titan Anti-spam & Security WordPress plugin before 7.5.5 does not protect or remove the diagnostic archive it writes to the uploads folder when an administrator exports its logs, and names it after the export date alone, allowing unauthenticated visitors to download the Titan Anti-spam & Security WordPress plugin before 7.5.5's logs, including visitor IP addresses, and the site's system information.

CVE-2026-132082.description: The RSVPMaker for Toastmasters WordPress plugin before 6.9.3 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before outputting it back in an admin page, leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting which could be used against high privilege users such as admin.

CVE-2026-132089.description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not keep a subscriber's secret key out of the redirect it returns after a subscription request when double opt-in is enabled, allowing unauthenticated attackers to confirm a subscription for any email address without access to its mailbox and, when the address already has an unconfirmed subscription, to reset that record with their own details.

CVE-2026-132781.description: The Booking Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the plugin's 'booking' shortcode in all versions up to, and including, 12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on user supplied attributes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-133439.description: The Coupon Creator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when an administrator has enabled the 'Disable Print View' option (cctor_hide_print_link), as this setting is required to reach the vulnerable else branch; the default configuration is not affected.

CVE-2026-133471.description: The Fastcache by Host.it plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the 's' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.14 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. This code path is only reachable when both the Light Images feature and the DOMDocument entity-decode branch are enabled (lightimgs_status = 1 and img_processing_entity_decode = 1), which reflect the default plugin configuration.

CVE-2026-119180.description: The PublishPress Tag Groups: Stylish Displays For Your Tags and Categories plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'column_gap' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload bypasses wp_kses_post sanitization on save because it contains no HTML tags — only a double-quote character within shortcode attribute syntax that breaks out of the style attribute at render time.

CVE-2026-119182.description: The PublishPress Tag Groups: Stylish Displays For Your Tags and Categories plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'separator' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is possible because wp_kses_post applied on save treats HTML-entity-encoded payloads as inert text, but the plugin's own check_attributes() function calls html_entity_decode() on the separator value before passing it to unescaped output, reconstituting live markup at render time.

CVE-2026-122161.description: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'hover_custom_background' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. wp_kses_post applied to post content on save does not parse shortcode attribute text, allowing injected double-quotes to survive storage and break out of the style attribute context at render time.

CVE-2026-122221.description: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'section_title_tag' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Although the plugin ships a resolveSectionTitleTag() helper that enforces an [h1–h6, p] allow-list, the accordion render path never invokes it, and the wp_kses_post sanitization applied to post_content on save does not parse shortcode attribute text, leaving the malicious value stored verbatim.

CVE-2026-122223.description: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'values[text_shadow_color]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wp_kses_post sanitization applied at save time does not strip the payload because it is stored as URL-encoded JSON inside a shortcode attribute, containing no literal HTML tags for kses to tokenize, leaving the malicious value intact until render time.

CVE-2026-123086.description: The PublishPress Revisions: Duplicate Posts, Submit, Approve and Schedule Content Changes plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.4 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to permanently force-delete arbitrary trashed posts, pages, and revisions owned by any user, including higher-privileged users. The required nonce is trivially harvested by any Contributor-level user because the static 'revisions-deleted' nonce action is emitted in a redirect header on the init hook before WordPress enforces edit.php's capability check, and once obtained it authorizes deletion of any trashed post or revision on the site.

CVE-2026-125011.description: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-126701.description: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wp_kses_post filter applied during save is ineffective against tagless attribute-breakout payloads, as it only strips disallowed HTML tags and cannot neutralize a payload containing no '<' characters; the element_id is then echoed without esc_attr() inside a data-id HTML attribute in template-tab.php.

CVE-2026-129095.description: The Social Media Auto Poster – Schedule & Publish to Buffer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.9. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to delete Buffer sync log history for and disclose Buffer sync log contents of arbitrary posts, including those authored by administrators. The nonce used as the sole gate is not bound to any specific post ID, so a nonce harvested from the attacker's own draft editor screen is valid against any arbitrary post ID submitted in the request.

CVE-2026-129096.description: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-129220.description: The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Missing Authorization in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.4 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with everest_forms_create_forms capabilities, to activate any already-installed inactive plugin on the server by supplying an arbitrary slug, triggering its activation hooks and escalating privileges up to administrator level. Exploitation requires that a site administrator has delegated the everest_forms_create_forms capability to a lower-privileged role via the plugin's Role & Permission feature, and that at least one inactive installed plugin whose main file follows the slug/slug.php naming convention exists on the server.

CVE-2026-130148.description: The YMC Filter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 3.14.1 via the 'post_status' parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to extract retrieve rendered grid HTML containing titles, excerpts, author names, dates, categories, tags, and thumbnails of private, draft, pending, and future posts they do not have permission to view. Exposure only occurs when an administrator has configured at least one non-publish status in the filter grid's Appearance → Post Status setting, as attacker-supplied statuses are intersected with this administrator-defined allowlist before being passed to WP_Query.

CVE-2026-131577.description: The WSMS (formerly WP SMS): SMS Notifications, OTP Login and WooCommerce SMS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 7.2.14. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to send arbitrary SMS messages to attacker-chosen phone numbers from the site's trusted sender ID, incurring per-message gateway charges to the site owner and enabling SMS spam or phishing campaigns.

CVE-2026-104904.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in versions up to, and including, 7.9.1 This is due to su_get_current_url() interpolating the raw Host request header into the authority portion of a URL that is then passed to esc_url() — which by design preserves '[' and ']' inside the authority so IPv6 literal hosts remain valid — and the [su_qrcode] shortcode substituting that value into its data attribute (the documented %CURRENT_URL% token) before feeding it to do_shortcode(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to include arbitrary PHP files that reside within the active theme's root directory (bounded because '/' inside an attribute value terminates parse_url()'s host and is then percent-encoded and stripped), and — when the shipped-default 'Unsafe features' option remains on — to read arbitrary post meta of any post, on any front-end page that renders [su_qrcode data="%CURRENT_URL%"].

CVE-2026-107713.description: The Flutterwave Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form_id' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The storing endpoint is accessible without authentication because the required nonce is publicly exposed on any front-end page rendering the plugin's [flw-pay-form], [flw-pay-button], or [flw-donation-form] shortcodes, allowing any unauthenticated visitor to scrape and reuse it.

CVE-2026-116619.description: The MetForm – Contact Form, Survey, Quiz, Conditional Forms, Form Templates & Custom Form Builder for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mf-te (the form-builder-chosen name of the Text Editor field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a published form containing a Text Editor block; the form's public markup exposes the submission nonce as data-form-nonce, allowing any unauthenticated visitor to satisfy the only submission barrier and store the malicious payload.

CVE-2026-118059.description: The MailerLite – Signup forms (official) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form_id' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.27 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to approve a comment containing the malicious shortcode, after which any page rendering the Latest Comments block with excerpts enabled will trigger the injected script for all visitors.

CVE-2026-119632.description: The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'textarea-N (rich-text draft value, saved as Save-and-Continue draft meta)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.58.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the targeted form to have a Rich-Text Textarea field with Save-and-Continue enabled and public submission permissions — once a crafted draft is saved, the payload executes whenever any user, including an administrator, resumes the draft or opens the Draft ID link from the Forminator Submissions screen.

CVE-2026-120485.description: The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'url' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has added the Author URL column to the Comments screen layout and that the site accepts unauthenticated comments, both of which are default WordPress and plugin configurations.

CVE-2026-120486.description: The ShortPixel Image Optimizer – Optimize Images, Convert WebP & AVIF plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.6.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the administrator to have enabled the 'Deliver WebP/AVIF images using the ShortPixel CDN' (useCDN) option, after which any unauthenticated visitor can submit a comment containing a crafted url() payload inside an allowed HTML construct such as <acronym title="...">, which WordPress comment kses preserves on save; the dangerous attribute-boundary breakout occurs only at render time inside the ob_start output-buffer rewriter, where kses does not apply.

CVE-2026-120529.description: The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The kses sanitization pass in classes/Sanitize/Kses.php uses wp_kses_allowed_html('post') augmented with iframe[src] and the data: protocol; because wp_kses_attr_check accepts any data-* attribute on any allowed tag without inspecting its value, a payload embedded inside a data-ac-tip attribute survives intact and is subsequently assigned to innerHTML by assets/js/table.js, bypassing the apparent mitigation entirely.

CVE-2026-120676.description: The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upload-1 (the File Upload field's element_id)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.58.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is an incomplete fix for CVE-2024-1794; exploitation requires that the Forminator form's File Upload field is left at plugin defaults (no 'custom-files' restriction configured) and that the server maps no Content-Type to the .rtx extension — the default behavior of the Debian/Ubuntu Apache package used by the official WordPress Docker image and many shared hosts.

CVE-2026-120679.description: The Redux Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '<opt_name>[<color-field-id>]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.17 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wp_kses_post() sanitization applied via Redux_Helpers::sanitize_array() is bypassed — not broken — because an <a class="thickbox" title="&lt;img onerror=...&gt;"> payload uses only kses-allowed tags and attributes, with the entity-encoded onerror handler surviving storage as inert text that the browser decodes when WordPress core's thickbox.js reads the title attribute and writes it into the modal as HTML. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-120738.description: The Organize Media Folder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'EXIF.DateTimeOriginal' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.00 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This bypass of wp_filter_post_kses means the injected payload survives regardless of the uploader's unfiltered_html capability; Subscriber-level access becomes sufficient when a front-end attachment-upload integration such as bbPress with forumAttachments is active, and exploitation requires no special configuration because the %created_timestamp% placeholder is included in the caption template by default. Exploitation by attackers with subscriber-level access and above requires that bbPress and gd-bbpress-attachments (forumAttachments) are installed and configured so that Subscribers/Participants can post attachments through a frontend forum form. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.

CVE-2026-125039.description: The EZ SQL Reports Shortcode Widget and DB Backup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'User-Agent header (stored to comment_agent)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.26.45 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that an administrator has saved a report whose SQL query selects attacker-controlled data such as comment_agent, and that the attacker can identify the saved report's slug — a condition trivially met when the administrator publishes the report on a public page via the [SQLREPORT] shortcode.

CVE-2026-126011.description: The Photo Gallery, Sliders, Proofing and Themes – NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the site administrator to have configured the Thickbox lightbox effect with the "Try to apply to all images" context (thumbEffectContext=all_images), and exploitation additionally depends on an administrator approving the attacker's initial comment so that subsequent comments from that author are auto-approved.

CVE-2026-130150.description: The Product Import Export for WooCommerce – CSV Product Importer & Exporter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author (initial store via wp-comments-post.php) / CSV cell on import' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.6.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit requires an administrator to approve the attacker's review, then export and re-import it using the plugin's default column mapping, with the import taking the INSERT branch — which occurs automatically on any site whose database table prefix is not the literal 'wp_', when the CSV has no comment_ID mapping, or when the original review has been trashed. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-131822.description: The Contact Form to Any API plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'your-message (any CF7 form field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The malicious payload is stored via a single unauthenticated POST to Contact Form 7's public REST feedback endpoint, which uses permission_callback __return_true and requires no authentication or prior interaction to submit.

CVE-2026-132620.description: The WPBot – AI ChatBot for WordPress & Growth Suite: SEO, AI Writer, Email Marketing, Social Media plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'text' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is triggered when an administrator opens the Chat Sessions screen, at which point the plugin's bundled Bootstrap 3.3.7 affix data-API passes the attacker-controlled data-target attribute value to jQuery as HTML, executing the injected script in the administrator's session.

CVE-2026-133361.description: The BlockStrap Page Builder – Bootstrap Blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.1.65 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker has previously had at least one comment approved for a given name and email address, allowing subsequent comments from that author to bypass moderation under WordPress's default policy; exploitation is also limited to sites using a block theme, which is the WordPress default.

CVE-2026-133369.description: The CodePeople Post Map for Google Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cpm_map[api_key]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The settings form nonce is itself rendered on the Subscriber-accessible page (reachable via a trailing-slash bypass of the slug guard), making nonce verification no real barrier to the unauthorized save.

CVE-2026-96991.description: The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via WebPage JSON-LD Description in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the target page renders a core/latest-comments block with the displayExcerpt option enabled, causing comment content to be incorporated into the WebPage JSON-LD description output in wp_head.

CVE-2026-125054.description: The SiteOrigin CSS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'class' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a Contributor-level or higher attacker to store a crafted class attribute value in a post, which then fires when a user with the edit_theme_options capability opens the Visual Inspector on the affected post and clicks anywhere in the preview iframe. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that a third-party plugin providing wp_kses_post()-filtered unauthenticated front-end submission is installed and configured, and a moderator approves the submission. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with contributor-level access and above.

CVE-2026-133963.description: A vulnerability was determined in MaysWind AriaNg-Native up to 1.3.14. Affected by this issue is the function shell.openPath of the file main/ipc/main-process.js of the component IPC Handler. This manipulation of the argument dir causes improper input validation. The attack can be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.3.15 can resolve this issue. Patch name: ac5a4bcf102f605b160f19fcc9fbaec67f9596d7. You should upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-104013.description: The WP Compress – Instant Performance & Speed Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 7.26.00 via the 'css' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. Exploiting the file read requires a preparatory unauthenticated request that plants a boundary directory by injecting a path traversal sequence into a cookie listed in WPC_CACHE_COOKIES (such as pll_language, present in the default list), meaning the plugin's cookie-cache feature must be enabled with at least one tracked cookie name configured.

CVE-2026-107632.description: The Unbounce Landing Pages plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 1.1.6. This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on the proxy error message that is persisted to the 'ub-proxy-error-message' option: unauthenticated attacker-controlled REQUEST_URI data is concatenated into the error string in UBHTTP::stream_request_curl()/stream_request_wp_remote() and stored via update_option(), then later echoed inside a <textarea> on the Unbounce Pages Diagnostics admin page without any escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user (an administrator viewing the Diagnostics screen) accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-116757.description: The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '_tutor_profile_bio' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected anchor payload uses a full-viewport invisible overlay (position:fixed; width:100vw; height:100vh; opacity:0) so that any click on the public profile page triggers the tutor-copy-text handler, which passes a browser-decoded data-text value to tutor_toast() where it is parsed as live HTML by jQuery.

CVE-2026-118049.description: The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.0 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to permanently delete any comment they authored anywhere on the site — including regular post comments and lesson comments — along with all replies to those comments authored by any other user, including Administrators and Instructors.

CVE-2026-118061.description: The VikBooking Hotel Booking Engine & PMS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'inquiry (array keys)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.8.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The endpoint's only access gate is a CSRF token that is publicly emitted on the unauthenticated inquiry page, making the injection reachable by any unauthenticated visitor without any precondition beyond loading that public page.

CVE-2026-119061.description: The VikBooking Hotel Booking Engine & PMS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'vbf<field_id>' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.8.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-119114.description: The WP Fastest Cache – WordPress Cache Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary directory deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the singleDeleteCache function in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). Successful exploitation requires either the Custom Permalinks plugin or the GeoDirectory plugin to be co-installed, as these provide the necessary mechanism to write a traversal-bearing permalink value into the database that WP Fastest Cache then consumes without validation.

CVE-2026-119216.description: The Stream – Activity Log & Audit Trail plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.4.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable on sites with 50 or fewer total users, as above that threshold the user filter uses an AJAX endpoint that returns entity-encoded labels and is not affected.

CVE-2026-119608.description: The Hustle – Email Marketing, Lead Generation, Optins, Popups plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'import_file' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.14.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have first delegated the hustle_edit_module capability to a lower-privileged role via the plugin's built-in Permissions screen; without that delegation, the import endpoint rejects non-Administrator users at the capability check.

CVE-2026-120119.description: The HUSKY – Products Filter for WooCommerce Professional plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'link (inner 'woof_text' query parameter)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.7 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The exploit requires a valid product_messenger nonce, which is issued by the woof_redraw_woof AJAX endpoint to any visitor when the shortcode's by_only attribute is set — an attribute that can itself be forced via the attacker-controlled woof_shortcode request parameter, making the nonce trivially obtainable by any logged-in user.

CVE-2026-120526.description: The WCFM Membership – WooCommerce Memberships for Multivendor Marketplace plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wcfm_membership_registration_form[store_name]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nonce required to reach the registration endpoint is publicly emitted on the /vendor-register/ page, making the endpoint fully reachable by unauthenticated attackers without any prior authentication or privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-120743.description: The Simply Schedule Appointments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'payment_method' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.13.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The stored payload is only rendered when an administrator navigates to the hidden support page (/wp-admin/admin.php?ssa-support-admin=1) and triggers the 'Fix appointment durations' action, a condition reliably engineered by the attacker by smuggling a '+1 day' suffix in the start_date field to create a persistent duration mismatch that routes the malicious booking through the vulnerable echo path. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-122230.description: The Thim Kit for Elementor – Pre-built Templates & Widgets for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the Post Comment widget is used with the Text Reveal entrance animation (Elementor class 'ekit--fx-word-reveal') on a Single Post template, and the comment widget must be within the initial viewport; once the first comment by an attacker is approved, or if comment moderation is disabled, subsequent payloads fire automatically for every visitor who loads the affected page.

CVE-2026-124214.description: The WP Data Access – App Builder for Tables, Forms, Dashboards, Charts & Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HyperlinkObject.label (percent-encoded)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.5.92 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the WordPress site to have a published Anonymous-access Registration Form app configured against a table with a HyperlinkObject column, and a legacy Data Project list using a $$link$$ Dynamic Hyperlink against that same column; given this configuration, any unauthenticated visitor can plant the payload.

CVE-2026-127133.description: The Stream – Activity Log & Audit Trail plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'group-name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires BuddyPress to be active with its Groups component enabled and default group-creation permissions in place, allowing any logged-in member to create groups.

CVE-2026-131609.description: The Germanized for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.first_name (Store API checkout) → stored on parent order; withdrawal get_first_name() fallback' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload is planted via an unauthenticated guest checkout order's billing first name through the WooCommerce Store API, with execution triggered by a subsequent unauthenticated withdrawal request submission whose nonce is publicly available on the /withdraw-from-contract/ page.

CVE-2026-133367.description: The WPC Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'variation' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.0.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nonce protecting the woobt_add_all_to_cart AJAX handler is emitted to all unauthenticated visitors via wp_localize_script, effectively nullifying the nonce as an authentication barrier and making the handler reachable without any login.

CVE-2026-133964.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Bytebase DBHub up to 2.0.0. Impacted is the function escapeHatchFunctionKeywords of the file src/utils/allowed-keywords.ts of the component Read Only Mode. The manipulation of the argument tool leads to incomplete blacklist. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-87092.description: The Unlimited Elements For Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.26 via the getFileContentByUrl function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. The nonce protecting the get_addon_output_data AJAX endpoint is emitted on the Elementor editor page, which is accessible to Contributors, making the endpoint reachable by any authenticated user at that privilege level or above.

CVE-2022-4998.description: A vulnerability was identified in kanishka-linux reminiscence 0.3 on Windows. This issue affects the function convert_html_pdf_with_chromium of the file pages/dbaccess.py of the component Chromium HTML-to-PDF Conversion Pipeline. Such manipulation of the argument url_name leads to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-128361.description: Improper Input Validation vulnerability in phoenixframework phoenix (Phoenix.Presence) allows an attacker who can join a channel to cause a denial of service via a non-string presence key. track/3,4 accepts any term as the presence key, such as a JSON object taken from a join payload. The key is converted with to_string/1 only later, in Phoenix.Presence.group/1, which raises Protocol.UndefinedError on a map. group/1 runs whenever presences are listed and when each presence diff is broadcast, together with the application's fetch/2, which can likewise raise on an unexpected key. Once such a key is tracked, every process that lists presences on the topic crashes, typically each channel that joins it, and presence diffs for the topic are lost. From 1.7.0 the diff runs in a Task.Supervisor.async task linked to the tracker shard, and Phoenix.Presence.handle_info/2 has no clause for its failure. The shard then terminates, taking down every channel and LiveView process tracked on it and erasing presence state for all its topics. Repeated joins exhaust the restart intensity and take down the application supervisor. This issue affects phoenix: from 1.2.0 before 1.5.16, from 1.6.0-rc.0 before 1.6.18, from 1.7.0-rc.0 before 1.7.25, and from 1.8.0-rc.0 before 1.8.17.

CVE-2026-129344.description: Uncaught Exception vulnerability in phoenixframework phoenix allows an unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service via a client-selected legacy serializer on binary channel broadcasts. When an application broadcasts {:binary, data} payloads on a channel topic, any client that connects without a vsn parameter, or with vsn=1.0.0, and joins that topic makes those broadcasts fail. Phoenix.Channel.Server.send/4 encodes each broadcast with every subscriber's own serializer inside the PubSub dispatch loop, calling fastlane!/1 with no rescue, and the negotiated Phoenix.Socket.V1.JSONSerializer raises Protocol.UndefinedError on a binary payload. Every binary broadcast on the topic then crashes the broadcasting process and skips every subscriber dispatched after the attacker. For broadcasts arriving from other nodes the loop runs in the PubSub adapter worker, whose repeated crashes restart the PubSub supervisor and empty the node's subscription registry while sockets stay connected. This issue affects phoenix: from 1.5.7 before 1.5.16, from 1.6.0-rc.0 before 1.6.18, from 1.7.0-rc.0 before 1.7.25, and from 1.8.0-rc.0 before 1.8.17.

CVE-2026-107654.description: The One to one user Chat by WPGuppy plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'userId' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.6 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The plugin's permission callback is trivially bypassed because it validates a JWT that the plugin itself signs using an attacker-supplied value from the guppy_guest_account cookie, and the guest code path (userType=0) skips the get_userdata() check that would confirm the userId corresponds to a real WordPress user.

CVE-2026-107747.description: The WP Custom Admin Interface plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'first_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.43 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-107771.description: The Speed Booster Pack ⚡ PageSpeed Optimization Suite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the plugin's Lazy load media option is enabled and that the attacker's comment is approved by a site administrator or via auto-approval.

CVE-2026-109196.description: The FV Player 8 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data.videos[].fv_wp_flowplayer_field_splash' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.1.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wp_ajax_fv_player_db_save handler's ownership and capability check is conditional on the presence of the data.update field; omitting it bypasses authorization entirely, allowing a Subscriber-level attacker to overwrite any existing video record using an enumerable video ID — and the valid nonce required by the endpoint is issued to every logged-in visitor of any page hosting the publicly accessible [fvplayer_editor] shortcode.

CVE-2026-116518.description: The ElasticPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'orderby' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload is stored in the ep_query_log transient for up to 24 hours after a single unauthenticated frontend GET request, and only fires when an administrator subsequently opens the Status Report page and expands the Failed Queries panel.

CVE-2026-119157.description: The PublishPress Capabilities: User Role Access Control, Admin Area Permissions plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'page_elements' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.53.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires an administrator to open a Profile Features capture window and save at least one of the attacker-supplied rows on the Profile Features screen, which represents the ordinary documented use of the feature and leaves no visible indication to the administrator that malicious data was submitted.

CVE-2026-119177.description: The Real Cookie Banner: GDPR & ePrivacy Cookie Consent plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.4.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the cookie banner has been activated by the site administrator (the plugin's primary onboarding step) and that at least one prior comment from the same name and email identity has already been approved, after which WordPress core's comment_previously_approved default auto-approves subsequent comments without administrator action.

CVE-2026-120736.description: The AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'your-message (any CF7 form field used in a form_field: tag)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.0.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have configured a public 'Guest submits a form' automation whose Send-an-email action embeds a form_field tag, after which the payload fires the next time any user opens the affected automation's email log entry.

CVE-2026-120745.description: The Paid Membership Plugin, Ecommerce, User Registration Form, Login Form, User Profile & Restrict Content – ProfilePress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'reg_bio' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.18.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The reg_bio parameter is accepted by the registration handler's allowlist even when the rendered registration form does not include a biography field, meaning an unauthenticated attacker can supply the payload via a raw POST request without needing a visible biography input on the form.

CVE-2026-122228.description: The ProfilePress – Paid Membership, Online Courses (LMS), Ecommerce, User Registration & Login Form, User Profile & Restrict Content plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 4.18.0 via the 'sortby<form_id>, filter<form_id>' parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract reconstruct any listed member's full e-mail address one character at a time via a boolean LIKE oracle, and enumerate users holding arbitrary usermeta keys such as ppress_billing_phone. The e-mail address oracle is reachable on any default install that used the plugin's 'Create pages' onboarding notice, because pp_email_address is enabled as a search field by default and the resulting directory page is published with no capability or nonce gate.

CVE-2026-122264.description: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'member[about]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the attacking subscriber to have met the default antispam threshold of at least 3 forum posts before the account editing page becomes accessible.

CVE-2026-123830.description: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data[display_name]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires public user registration to be enabled (users_can_register=1) and a valid _wpfnonce fetched from the public sign-up page, but is otherwise fully unauthenticated.

CVE-2026-123970.description: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'thread[body]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful execution of the injected script is limited to viewers whose forum access profile denies attachment viewing (va=0 or caa=0), meaning exploitation depends on an administrator having configured a custom forum access profile that permits reading but denies attachment viewing — this is not the default shipped configuration.

CVE-2026-124216.description: The Orphans plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.4.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a two-step comment chain: a benign first comment must be approved under a given name and email so that WordPress's comment_previously_approved mechanism auto-publishes the attacker's payload comment without moderation.

CVE-2026-124248.description: The GPTranslate – Multilingual AI Translation Agent for WordPress: Translate Your Site with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.34.17 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the plugin's non-default 'HTML DOM method' to be enabled for server-side translation, and a translation row for the target language-prefixed URL must exist to arm the output buffer that routes page content through the vulnerable Simple HTML DOM parser.

CVE-2026-124976.description: The Swift Performance Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '<attacker-chosen parameter name>' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.7.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires that an administrator has configured at least one Cacheable AJAX Action via the plugin's AJAX Cache feature, a condition attackers can confirm by probing for a swift-performance: HIT response header.

CVE-2026-126705.description: The WP Job Portal – AI-Powered Recruitment System for Company or Job Board website plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'columns[<attacker-chosen key>]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.0 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

CVE-2026-130323.description: The Accept Stripe Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'href of any <a> element containing 'asp_action=show_pp&product_id='' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that a user clicks the attacker-placed comment link to trigger the sink; however, if the non-default 'Prefetch Payment Popup Scripts' option is enabled, execution occurs on page load with no user interaction required.

CVE-2026-129794.description: The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that the declared size fits in the actual buffer. A master can write up to 2016 bytes into a buffer the application may have sized much smaller.

CVE-2026-129795.description: When the last EoE fragment has the TIME_APPEND flag set, the handler subtracts 4 from rxframeoffset to strip the timestamp. There is no check that rxframeoffset is at least 4. A fragment carrying fewer than 4 bytes of payload that is also marked LAST causes rxframeoffset to wrap to 0xFFFFFFFC, which is then stored as the buffer length and handed to the TCP/IP stack.

CVE-2026-129796.description: The CoE SDO download handler for flexible-length objects (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, and similar) does not check that the master-declared transfer size fits within the object before writing. Two distinct writes are affected: the VISIBLE_STRING zero-padding memset and the first-frame copy into the object buffer.

CVE-2026-129797.description: SDO_downloadsegment is called whenever a mailbox frame carries the DOWNLOADSEGREQ command byte, regardless of whether a segmented download is actually in progress. ESCvar.data, which the handler writes through, is NULL until a segmented transfer is started. A master can send a DOWNLOADSEGREQ at any time and write through a NULL or stale pointer.

CVE-2026-129798.description: The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in total. A master can keep sending non-last segments until the pointer has walked past the end of the object buffer or the complete-access staging buffer.

CVE-2026-129799.description: A CoE SDO request for index 0xFFFF matches the object list terminator entry instead of returning not-found. The terminator has a NULL objdesc pointer. Callers dereference it without checking, crashing the slave.

CVE-2026-129800.description: sizeOfPDO, called during state transitions, uses the subindex-0 count of the SM-assign and PDO-mapping objects as loop bounds without checking those counts against the descriptor array sizes. On builds where those subindex-0 values are writable via SDO, a master can write 0xFF and cause sizeOfPDO to read past the end of the descriptor arrays on the next transition to SAFEOP.

CVE-2026-129801.description: The FoE DATA frame handler computes the payload length from the master-supplied mailbox length field and passes it directly to FOE_fwrite. The length is checked against the remaining file capacity but not against the physical mailbox buffer size. A master can declare a large length while sending a short frame, causing FOE_fwrite to read past the end of the mailbox buffer.

CVE-2026-129802.description: EOE_set_ip reads each network parameter field (MAC, IP, subnet, gateway, DNS IP, DNS name) from the mailbox payload before checking whether the payload is large enough to contain them. The single bounds check at the end of the function does not prevent the reads from happening. A master can send a Set-IP frame with all flags set and mbxheader.length equal to the minimum, causing all reads to access memory past the end of the payload.

CVE-2026-129803.description: The CoE entry gate accepts frames with mbxheader.length as low as COE_MINIMUM_LENGTH (8), but a normal SDO Download requires at least COE_HEADERSIZE (10) bytes of CoE payload to carry its header fields. With mbxheader.length of 8 or 9, the segmented-transfer branch misevaluates due to unsigned wrap, leaving the declared SDO size unclamped. copy2mbx then reads that many bytes starting past the end of the actual payload and writes them into the object buffer.

CVE-2026-129804.description: FOE_read and FOE_write store the filename length as uint8_t, truncating it modulo 256. When (mbxheader.length - ESC_FOEHSIZE) is a multiple of 256, the length becomes 0. Additionally, a request whose mailbox length equals ESC_FOEHSIZE exactly also produces a length of 0 without any truncation. In both cases FOE_fopen calls strncmp with a length of 0, which always returns equal, so the first registered file whose password is 0 is opened regardless of the filename the master sent.

CVE-2026-129805.description: An object dictionary entry can carry write-access flags and still have a NULL data pointer, for example when a constant value is held in the value field rather than in addressable storage. The CoE SDO download handler checked write access but not whether storage was present, then wrote the master-supplied payload through the NULL pointer.

CVE-2026-129806.description: The CoE SDO upload handler enters its normal-response path (used for objects longer than 4 bytes) and passes (objd + nsub)->data directly to the pre-object handler and to the response copy. Entries that hold a constant in the value field have data set to NULL; a master can request such an entry and cause a NULL pointer dereference in the upload path.

CVE-2026-129807.description: The FoE file table allows entries to omit a write handler by setting write_function to NULL, making the file read-only. FOE_fopen did not check whether write_function was present before accepting a write request; a master sending a WRQ for a read-only file caused a call through a NULL function pointer.

CVE-2026-129808.description: The EoE receive and transmit paths call the handle_recv_buffer and fetch_send_buffer callbacks without first checking whether they are set. Both callbacks are documented as optional; an application that omits either one causes a call through a NULL function pointer when the first EoE frame arrives or when the transmit polling loop runs.

CVE-2026-129809.description: ESC_foeprocess can be reached by an incoming mailbox frame before the application calls FOE_config to supply the file table and flush buffer pointers. When foe_cfg or its fbuffer field is NULL the handler dereferenced those pointers while processing the frame, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

CVE-2026-129810.description: ESC_eoeprocess and ESC_eoeprocess_tx can be reached before the application calls EOE_config to supply the callback table pointer. When eoe_cfg is NULL the receive handler dereferenced it while processing an incoming EoE frame, and the transmit polling function dereferenced it on each cycle, causing NULL pointer dereferences.

CVE-2026-129811.description: The PDO mapping bit lengths stored in the mapping objects are writable by the master via SDO. sizeOfPDO summed them without checking the total against the size of the rxpdo[] or txpdo[] process data buffers. A master can craft a mapping whose total bit count exceeds those buffers, causing COE_pdoPack and COE_pdoUnpack to write past their ends during each process data cycle after the PREOP to SAFEOP transition.

CVE-2026-129812.description: An object dictionary entry that holds a constant has no process data storage and carries a NULL data pointer. sizeOfPDO did not check for this when resolving a mapped entry to its descriptor. A master that maps such an entry to a PDO causes COE_pdoPack or COE_pdoUnpack to dereference the NULL data pointer on every process data exchange after the mapping is activated.

CVE-2026-129813.description: The CoE complete-access download handler iterated over all subindices of an object and wrote the master-supplied payload into each writable entry. Entries that hold a constant have write-access flags set but carry a NULL data pointer. The handler did not check for this and wrote the master payload through the NULL pointer.

CVE-2026-129814.description: The SDO Information Get Object Description and Get Entry Description responses copy the object or entry name into the mailbox data area and then write a null terminator byte. The copy loops ran up to the last available byte in the buffer, leaving no room for the terminator. When an object or entry name exactly fills the available space the terminator is written one byte past the end of the mailbox data buffer.

ab946592bf354e8fe90b8459.excerpt: PHP published advisories for several critical vulnerabilities on November 19, 2026, with fixed PHP releases published on November 18 and 19. WordPress site owners should update PHP as soon as possible. CVE-2026-129289 is the most directly relevant issue for WordPress. On an affected PHP-FPM server, an unauthenticated attacker may be able to make PHP run a request that never passed through the web server’s normal checks. Not every WordPress site is exposed. The demonstrated attack requires a vulnerable PHP version and a web server that reuses its private connections to PHP-FPM. Standard NGINX configurations do not enable that reuse by default. The Wordfence Threat Response team confirmed unauthenticated code execution in an isolated WordPress lab. The same test did not run code after PHP was updated or after reuse of the web-server-to-PHP connection was disabled. Fixed releases for the affected supported branches are 8.2.36, 8.3.37, 8.4.28, and 8.5.13. Hosting vendors may also provide backported fixes under different package version numbers. On November 19, 2026, PHP published CVE-2026-129289 , a critical PHP-FPM vulnerability with a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.2 out of 10 . Successful exploitation can let an attacker run PHP code with the permissions of the website’s PHP process. This is a vulnerability in PHP, not WordPress Core, a plugin, or a theme. CVE-2025-61963.description: Improper input validation within the AmdPlatformRasSmm driver could allow an attacker with privileged access to overwrite SMRAM, potentially resulting in arbitrary code execution.

CVE-2026-0462.description: Insufficient Granularity of Access Control in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow a malicious hypervisor to potentially redirect accesses to MMIO memory resulting in loss of guest memory integrity.

CVE-2026-133983.description: A vulnerability was detected in eigent-ai eigent up to 1.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file backend/app/controller/chat_controller.py of the component Local Agent Control API. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack may be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.0.3 addresses this issue. The patch is named 59f43afcb1b0ba7b2de8c65d585124f196c4aa17. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-28235.description: Improper address validation in the AMD RAID Configuration Driver could allow an attacker with administrative access to read arbitrary kernel memory, potentially resulting in loss of confidentiality.

CVE-2026-40671.description: Incomplete cleanup during VMRUN error handling could allow access to a Secure Encrypted Virtualization-Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP) guest register state, potentially resulting in information disclosure and impacts to confidentiality.

CVE-2026-74127.description: Improper verification of a cryptographic signature in the PSP Boot ROM of AMD Zeppelin (Zen1/Zen+) processors could allow an attacker with local access to the SPI flash to bypass secure boot authentication, potentially resulting in arbitrary unsigned code execution at full Platform Security Processor privilege, loss of confidentiality, loss of integrity of the host boot chain, and persistent loss of availability.

CVE-2026-133985.description: A flaw has been found in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /usr/sbin/restore_config.cgi. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor explains: "I am not able to confirm if such vulnerability exists as the product has been EOL for more than 15 years. We will send out an announcement letting customers know." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

CVE-2026-124626.description: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.5 through 4.0.9, the plugin matches path-scoped Express middleware with a matcher that requires a non-empty value for a dynamic segment, while Fastify's router accepts an empty parameter or wildcard value. When a route and an Express middleware mount share a dynamic pattern, a request with an empty segment matches the Fastify route and runs the handler while the middleware mounted on that pattern is skipped, so on a scoped mount an unauthenticated request can reach a protected handler. No special configuration is required, and the practical impact depends on what the empty value selects in the application. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.10, and users should upgrade to 4.0.10 or later.

CVE-2026-129504.description: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.0 through 4.0.9, the plugin joins a path-scoped middleware's mount path to the Fastify plugin prefix by string concatenation, so when the plugin prefix ends with a slash or the mount path omits its leading slash, the resulting Express mount path does not line up with the route the Fastify router serves. Express then fails to match and passes the request on while the Fastify router still dispatches the route, so the middleware is silently skipped. An application that uses path-scoped Express middleware for authentication or authorization inside a prefixed plugin can expose protected routes to unauthenticated clients, with no crafted request and no non-default option required, and string, array, and regular-expression mount paths are all affected. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.10, and users should upgrade to 4.0.10 or later.

CVE-2026-129850.description: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.0 through 4.0.9, when Fastify routing is configured to be case-insensitive, the router folds the request path to lower case in a way that maps certain non-ASCII Unicode characters to ASCII letters, but @fastify/express matches Express mount paths against the decoded path without applying the same folding. The two disagree, so a request that spells a letter of a mount path with an equivalent Unicode character is routed to the protected handler while the path-scoped middleware mounted on that path never matches and is skipped. An unauthenticated client can therefore reach a handler that an authentication, authorization, or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect, though only when the application enables case-insensitive routing and the mount path contains an affected letter. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.10, and users should upgrade to 4.0.10 or later.

CVE-2026-133120.description: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions before 4.0.10, the plugin passes Express a request URL that does not always match the path Fastify's router dispatched, so path-scoped Express middleware can be skipped while the route handler still runs.
